wizard_login.title: Set up Nest Protect
wizard_login.description:
Nest Protect is not exposed through the official Google Nest SDM API, even when your alarms appear in the Google Home app. This integration therefore uses the Nest web authentication flow.

Recommended: run `python scripts/nest_protect_cookie_wizard.py` on your computer. The wizard opens a real browser, lets you sign in normally, captures the required request data locally, and prints one block you can paste here.

Paste the full wizard output block into the first field. The separate Issue Token URL and Cookie header fields are only for legacy or emergency fallback use.

data_description.wizard_output: Paste the complete block printed by scripts/nest_protect_cookie_wizard.py.
data_description.issue_token: Fallback only: full URL beginning with https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/iframerpc.
data_description.cookies: Fallback only: full Cookie request header captured by the wizard or manual troubleshooting.

error.network_timeout: The Google/Nest request timed out. Try again after checking your network connection.
error.authentication_rejected: Google/Nest rejected these credentials. Run the wizard again and do not log out of home.nest.com afterward.
error.invalid_issue_token: Invalid Issue Token URL. Paste the full issueToken request URL, including all query parameters.
error.incomplete_cookie_header: Cookie header looks incomplete. Copy the full Cookie header from the oauth2/iframe Network request.
error.no_devices_found: Authentication succeeded, but no Nest Protect devices were found on this account.
error.unexpected_response: Nest returned an unexpected response. Try again or open an issue with redacted diagnostics.
